answer: Each identity locks 70 credits, filing one signed plume of work. A bridge check matches each claim to its plume; two contradictory proofs for one job slash 30% of the bond and freeze it an epoch. Anyone may whisper a contradiction; auditors verify it publicly. Filing costs 45 first, then 45+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,542,500 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented plumes fail the bridge check and slash both sides; honest agents pay 45 once.
